body:
This PR modifies the `InterpolatingTimeVaryingInput0D` to work with interpolating with multiple points. To use it, you can pass a vector of times and a matrix of size (number of points, number of times) to the constructor. It behaves like all the other `TimeVaryingInput`s.

There are minimal checks done in the constructor, so it is the responsibility of the user to check that the data is correct. This was done because data validation between space and input data is difficult to do.

Note that I asked a LLM to write most of the code.

title: Add support for interpolating for multiple columns
